headline: Malaysian Palm Oil Futures Fall 3% Dragged by Rival Edible Oils
summary: Benchmark palm oil futures on the Bursa Malaysia Derivatives Exchange fell 3.17% to 4,247 ringgit per metric ton, extending losses for a third consecutive trading session.
why: Palm oil is the world's most widely consumed vegetable oil, heavily traded on international agricultural commodity exchanges.

impacts.name: Malaysian Palm Oil
impacts.why: Weakness in international edible oil prices dragged down Malaysian palm oil futures.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Declines in global vegetable oil markets drove liquidations in Malaysian palm contracts.
